body.title: Build the key-value cross-check
body.summary: Add the pure cross-check used by convertText: normalise the raw text and each key value (whitespace collapsed, case folded, surrounding quotes dropped), match alphanumeric values on token boundaries, accept an empty keyValues list on schema alone with a log line saying nothing was checked, and report the missing values by name.
acceptanceChecks: 'Fix-Login' is found in 'fix-login' with extra spaces
an empty keyValues list is accepted and logged as unchecked
the missing values are returned by name

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/cross-check.test.ts: key-value matching normalises whitespace and case and drops surrounding quotes
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/cross-check.test.ts: an alphanumeric key value matches on token boundaries, so '12' is not found in '123'
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/cross-check.test.ts: an empty keyValues result is accepted on schema alone
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/cross-check.test.ts: the missing values are returned by name
